_note: Spell catalogue. Mastery (WorldState.skills[id]) drives power and aim. A spell is only castable once Mika knows it: arcane_orb is known from the start; the others need their incantation knowledge (from reading) and become reliable through practice. Latin: classical forms, translations kept here. Combat: 'damage' scales a spell's power against creatures; 'incantation_short' is what an Adept says (Expert+ casts silently). 'caster' notes whose signature a spell is (others may still learn it later).

arcane_orb.name: Arcane Orb
arcane_orb.summary: A sphere of raw arcane light. Stirs anything that holds magic.

wind_gust.name: Wind Gust
wind_gust.summary: A shaped push of air. A weak gust only disturbs; a strong one can put out a flame.

water_ripple.name: Water Ripple
water_ripple.summary: Calls water into motion: ripples on still water, steam against fire.

ember_control.name: Ember Control
ember_control.summary: Feeds and guides an existing flame. It cannot make fire from nothing yet.

rune_activation.name: Rune Activation
rune_activation.summary: Wakes a carved sign. Only works on runes and marked stones.

elemental_charge.name: Elemental Charge
elemental_charge.translation: Power of the elements, gather in me!
elemental_charge.summary: Gathers ambient power into the caster: the next spell is stronger.

mist_veil.name: Mist Veil
mist_veil.summary: The first joined breath: water lifted by wind into a veil of mist. Needs both breaths to answer reliably.

umbral_lance.name: Umbral Lance
umbral_lance.summary: A narrow spear of gathered shadow edged in gold light. Fast and precise; it cracks stone and disperses wisps.
